name: No Matter the Cost: Carden's Diary offers its quest, then shows the journal once the quest is taken
contract: Carden's Diary 2300689 (type 2 quest giver, lock 43 'Reading') offers No Matter the Cost 175043. The user found (playtest 2026-10-15) that after taking the quest the diary still opened the server's default 'Greetings, $N' gossip. The only recorded writing on the diary is the quest's own text (AscenSS 071126-233952, c3a0y5pCKpE 14:51), so once the quest is in the log or rewarded the diary shows that journal as npc_text 2300689; while the quest is not taken (including after abandoning it) the diary offers the quest. The case joins world phase 1 beside the world spawn 9980002.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the diary lies
Read the diary before taking its quest
the diary offers No Matter the Cost
Read the diary with the quest in the log
it shows Carden's journal, not the default greeting
